extras: Requires an Inklaw account and a personal sync token; the plugin connects to a remote server.
intentEvidence: This plugin pulls those finished notes (with their cover images and media) into your vault automatically
problem: Manually transferring and maintaining notes, media, and polished content from the Inklaw service into the Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: Sync the notes you forwarded to Inklaw straight into your Obsidian vault.

summary: Sync notes, media, and polished content forwarded to the Inklaw service directly into the Obsidian vault.
